items.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Signs Multiyear Global WiFi Patent Deal With Blacklisted Supplier
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) parent HP entered a multi year global WiFi patent licensing agreement with U.S. blacklisted Huawei, covering a broad portfolio of wireless networking IP. The deal follows a series of legal disputes between the companies and formalizes cross licensing access to WiFi related patents across multiple regions. The agreement could influence HPE's future networking products, customer reach and approach to intellectual property risk management in key...
